name: zinterp_context_run_script_file
description: zInterp_Context::RunScriptFile opens source or prepared script streams, handles nested include frames, and delegates to RunString.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
RunScriptFile participates in the recursive zInterp execution loop with RunString, RunStream, and HandleBuiltinCommand, so dependency acceptance is made for the group rather than as an isolated leaf.
Binary Ninja/frontier output may show a stale x87/int80 artifact for the RunString call, but both function contracts are eax-only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4c1500 validates nested frame push/pop, prepared-script lookup, source fopen fallback, includeDepth increment, RunString delegation, non-prepared fclose, currentScriptFile restoration, and result propagation.
Native smokes cover nested source execution, macro propagation across included scripts, frame stack cleanup, and RunStream builtin behavior.
